verdict.rationale: Netlify ships first-party bindings that remove manual SDK and credential wiring. Blobs storage is accessed with a one-line getStore() call. Netlify Database provisions managed Postgres instantly. The AI Gateway connects to AI models without managing API keys. Evidence is marketing-level only, and third-party services such as Turso appear only as integration listings with no proof that credentials are auto-wired. Missing for 10: code-level docs showing how the Netlify Database connection is injected, evidence that third-party integrations auto-provision credentials or bindings, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect my code to external services like databases, APIs, and storage through native bindings with minimal boilerplate instead of hand-wiring SDKs and credentials

citations.quote: Instantly provision a production-grade database with Netlify Database or use Blobs as a simple key/value store or lightweight database.
Connect to popular AI models within your project code and connect to them seamlessly without managing API keys.
Add instant databases and file storage
